learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Drowsiness and Sleep Stages.
Apply Drowsiness and Sleep Stages to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Drowsiness attenuates alpha and introduces theta; N2 includes spindles and K-complexes; deeper NREM shows delta; REM has low-voltage mixed frequency with eye movements.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Sleep architecture, asymmetry and transients require age and context. Sleep can activate epileptiform discharges.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Prevents state-related slowing from being called pathology and supports sleep-related diagnosis.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Drowsy theta is not automatically “excess theta.”

quizBank.question: Which statement best captures Drowsiness and Sleep Stages?
options: Drowsiness attenuates alpha and introduces theta; N2 includes spindles and K-complexes; deeper NREM shows delta; REM has low-voltage mixed frequency with eye movements.
It provides a stand-alone psychiatric diagnosis
It is unaffected by state and artifact
Its interpretation requires no clinical context
quizBank.explanation: Drowsiness attenuates alpha and introduces theta; N2 includes spindles and K-complexes; deeper NREM shows delta; REM has low-voltage mixed frequency with eye movements.

quizBank.question: What is the safest clinical principle for Drowsiness and Sleep Stages?
options: Integrate raw signal quality, state, method and clinical context
Assume a coloured map shows exact anatomy
Treat statistical rarity as proof of disorder
quizBank.explanation: EEG and QEEG interpretation requires converging evidence, technical validity and clinical context.

quizBank.question: Which error is most important to avoid in Drowsiness and Sleep Stages?
options: Drowsy theta is not automatically “excess theta.”
quizBank.explanation: Drowsy theta is not automatically “excess theta.”
